children: India's TVS Credit Services plans to raise 10 billion rupees ($104.30 million), including a greenshoe option of 2.50 billion rupees, through the sale of bonds maturing in three years, three bankers said on Thursday.
It will pay an annual coupon of 7.29% and has invited bids for the issue on Friday, they said.
The company did not respond to a Reuters email seeking comment.
